blocks.title: Digital entrepreneurship
blocks.text: Digital entrepreneurship is using technology and online platforms (the Internet, social media, e-commerce and digital tools) to create, manage and grow business ideas and services.

Digital entrepreneurs solve real problems with innovative digital solutions and use social media, e-commerce websites and freelancing platforms to reach customers worldwide. Innovation, creating new products and services for changing market needs, is central, and the field lets students turn creative ideas into successful businesses.

blocks.title: Do you know?
blocks.text: Most successful entrepreneurs are not born risk-takers; they develop risk-taking skills through experience.
Successful entrepreneurs and Pakistan's digital economy

items: Creative: always looking for new ideas to solve problems.
Hard-working and committed to their goals.
Confident and willing to take calculated risks.
Strong at decisions and problem solving.
Adaptable to changing markets and customer needs.

blocks.text: Entrepreneurship in Pakistan is growing fast with wider access to the Internet and mobile phones. Many young people start online businesses through social media, e-commerce and freelancing; the digital economy creates jobs in software development, digital marketing and online services; and government and private initiatives support startups, helping young people become job creators rather than job seekers.

A business opportunity is a problem in society that a product or service can solve. Entrepreneurs watch daily life to understand customer needs and market demand, study behaviour, preferences and trends, and use surveys, feedback and online data to find gaps in the market. Technology opens opportunities in education, healthcare, agriculture and business (Fig 9.4): online learning lets students study from home, mobile apps help farmers improve crops, and digital payments make transactions easier and safer.

blocks.text: Digital platforms provide entrepreneurs with tools to start, manage and grow their businesses online (as shown in Figure 9.4). They include social media, e-commerce websites and freelancing marketplaces. Social media helps in promoting products and reaching a large audience quickly. E-commerce platforms and online marketplaces let businesses sell products and services over the Internet, connecting sellers with customers without a physical store, which reduces costs and expands market reach. Freelancing and remote work let people offer skills such as graphic design, writing, programming and digital marketing to clients through online platforms, from home or any place with an Internet connection, giving flexibility, independent income and global access to job markets.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The book cites Figure 9.4 here, but Figure 9.4 shows technology-based solutions; the digital platforms (social media, e-commerce, freelancing) are shown in Figure 9.5.

items: Choose a product or service that meets a real customer need.
Decide the target audience, the price and how it will be delivered through digital platforms.
Set clear goals and plan the resources needed: time, money and skills.
Make a basic budget of costs and expected income to set prices and manage spending.
Build a team and communicate well, using meetings, messaging apps and online tools.

blocks.title: Do you know?
blocks.text: Most failed startups do not have a clear plan.

Good budgeting and resource management use money, time and skills without waste, keep the business profitable and support long-term success; strong teamwork and communication raise productivity in startups.

Innovation means creating new or better ideas, products or services that solve problems in better ways, and it keeps digital businesses competitive. Emerging technologies such as AI, cloud computing, blockchain and mobile apps help entrepreneurs build smarter, faster and cheaper solutions with global reach. AI helps analyse data and customer behaviour and improve decisions; mobile apps reach customers and sell products quickly; and digital services such as online payments, cloud storage and marketing tools cut costs.

blocks.title: Do you know?
blocks.text: AI tools can now design, write and even help run businesses.

Career paths in technology entrepreneurship include founding a startup, freelancing in programming, graphic design or digital marketing, app development, e-commerce management, online consultancy, and becoming an innovator who creates new digital solutions to real problems.
